title: Apple (AAPL) Price Target Increased to $250.00 by Analysts at S&P Equity Research
text:
Apple (AAPL) Price Target Increased to $250.00 by Analysts at S&P Equity Research Posted by Donald Scott | Sep 12th, 2018
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price objective raised by S&P Equity Research to $250.00 in a report published on Tuesday morning, The Fly reports. S&P Equity Research currently has an in-line rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. The analysts noted that the move was a valuation call.
A number of other brokerages also recently issued reports on AAPL. Morgan Stanley restated a buy rating and set a $245.00 price target (up previously from $232.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. DA Davidson restated a buy rating and set a $265.00 price target (up previously from $230.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. DZ Bank restated a buy rating on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, September 3rd. Canaccord Genuity restated a buy rating and set a $250.00 price target (up previously from $220.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 4th. Finally, Cascend Securities raised their price target on shares of Apple from $230.00 to $250.00 and gave the stock a buy rating in a report on Tuesday, September 4th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty-one have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of Buy and an average target price of $229.48. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL opened at $223.85 on Tuesday. The company has a market cap of $1,087.72 billion, a PE ratio of 24.31, a PEG ratio of 1.95 and a beta of 1.32. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. Apple has a 1 year low of $149.16 and a 1 year high of $229.67.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The business’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $1.67 EPS. sell-side analysts expect that Apple will post 11.74 EPS for the current fiscal year.
The firm also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, August 16th. Shareholders of record on Monday, August 13th were given a $0.73 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, August 10th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.30%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 31.70%.
In other Apple news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, July 9th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the completion of the transaction, the chief operating officer now owns 125,258 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $23,821,566.44. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link . Also, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 6,568 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, June 15th. The shares were sold at an average price of $188.81, for a total transaction of $1,240,104.08. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 79,476 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $15,005,863.56. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold a total of 384,968 shares of company stock valued at $82,292,858 in the last three months. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
A number of hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of the business. SP Asset Management purchased a new stake in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter worth $6,307,000. HRT Financial LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 233.0% during the 2nd quarter. HRT Financial LLC now owns 46,301 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,570,000 after purchasing an additional 32,395 shares during the last quarter. Planning Directions Inc. raised its stake in Apple by 6.8% during the 2nd quarter. Planning Directions Inc. now owns 18,512 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,427,000 after acquiring an additional 1,181 shares in the last quarter. LFA Lugano Financial Advisors SA acquired a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter worth $271,000. Finally, Chicago Partners Investment Group LLC raised its stake in Apple by 12.1% during the 2nd quarter. Chicago Partners Investment Group LLC now owns 39,984 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,402,000 after acquiring an additional 4,316 shares in the last quarter. 58.62% of the stock is owned by institutional investors.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
